trigger: The preregistration phrase 'L2 penalty 8.0 on theta in unconstrained logit space' does not uniquely define a shrinkage-to-zero center because theta=0 maps to minus infinity under the logit transform.

clarified_implementation.objective: sum prior-match bivariate-Poisson negative log likelihood + 8.0 * (theta / 0.35)^2
clarified_implementation.optimization: deterministic bounded one-dimensional minimization; no hyperparameter search
clarified_implementation.fallback: theta=0 if the optimizer fails or fewer than 100 prior matches are available
